evidence.quote: fee request proportionate to the class recovery
Whitcombe Reyes offers the lowest total outlay ($35 million), below the $40 million authorization.
Accept its term sheet; make no competing proposals.

summary: Fees were first raised by class counsel in the opening round, and the final deal proposed class relief and fees together rather than through a separate prior fee negotiation. Hargrove explicitly linked its fee request to class recovery by describing it as proportionate. Defense chose Whitcombe Reyes because it offered the lowest total outlay among competing class counsel, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label, but there is no clear evidence that Whitcombe sacrificed class relief for its own fee or that the court declaration was misleading.
